Independently executable exact programs verify witness counts and zeta.

value.rationale: The invariant rho(q,g) is an explicit research target. This settles a complete genus-four base-field case by pairing an exact all-degree theorem for arbitrary curves with an explicit quadratic-stable hyperelliptic witness. The previously tabled candidate zeta polynomial alone could not guarantee a smooth curve, so its actual realization has specific arithmetic-geometric relevance beyond a routine arithmetic identity. No generalization to other fields is claimed.
